title: Sphynx Cat Artist Portal
description: A hairless sphynx cat wearing glasses sits at a wooden table painting in a spiral notebook, with colorful paint dripping from its paws and the table. Through a crumbling archway, a red dragon breathes fire while two red demons ride a motorcycle along a purple road under a swirling galaxy sky.
prompt: A hairless sphynx cat with glasses sits at a wooden table covered in a white cloth dripping with colorful paint, focused on painting in a spiral notebook with a yellow pencil. The cat has blue and yellow paint on its body. Behind it is a crumbling wall with graffiti of aliens and creatures. A large broken stone archway reveals a surreal landscape with a purple winding road, where two red demon figures ride a motorcycle, and a large red dragon flies overhead breathing a stream of yellow fire. The sky features a swirling purple and green galaxy with stars. Vibrant colors, detailed fantasy illustration.
